segments.sn55.15:1.1: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sabbaduggativinipātabhayaṃ samatikkanto hoti.
segments.sn55.15:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti –
segments.sn55.15:1.4: itipi so bhagavā…pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
segments.sn55.15:1.7: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi…pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
segments.sn55.15:1.8: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sabbaduggativinipātabhayaṃ samatikkanto hotī”ti.

lines: Pañcame sabbaduggativinipātabhayaṃ samatikkantoti manussadobhaggena saddhiṃ cattāro apāyā paṭikkhittā. 6.
